description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use whenever the person asks to change records in a system whose AI agent may change them: every change goes through here first, and nothing is written. Pick one action and give one item per record, at most 25. set_fields: fills, corrects, empties or makes records with the fields describe_record_type lists (type, and id unless it makes a new record; set holds field keys and new values, clear the keys to empty). update_fields: New values for fields of a record that exist in the person's own system, such as a lead status or a custom field, by their own names. (type, id, fields). move_stage: A record moved to another stage or status of its pipeline, such as a deal to proposal sent or to won; a won or lost stage closes the record. (type, id, stage; optional pipeline). add_note: A note on a record's timeline in the person's system. (type, id, text; optional at, user). add_task: A task or follow up on a record in the person's system, such as a call next week; the system may notify the user it is assigned to. (type, id, subject, due_at; optional notes, priority, task_kind, done, user). update_task: A task or follow up that already exists moved to another date, retitled, reassigned or marked done, by the id list_related_records or search_tasks gives it; only what is given changes. (task_id; optional type, id, subject, due_at, notes, done, user). log_activity: A call or meeting that took place, written on a record's timeline in the person's system; nothing is dialled and no invitation is sent. (type, id, kind, title; optional notes, at, end_at, user). add_line_item: A product or service line added to a record, such as a deal, with its name, quantity and price. (type, id, name, quantity, unit_price; optional notes). send_record: An invoice or quote emailed to the customer by the person's own system, from its own email address. The customer receives it, and only the person can approve it. (type, id; optional email). convert_estimate: A new invoice with the lines of a quote, linked to it and not sent; nothing is made when the quote already has one. (type, id). link_records: Two records linked in the person's system, such as a contact to a deal, or an existing note or task to another record; nothing changes when they are linked already. (type, id, other_type, other_id). unlink_records: The link between two records removed; both records stay as they are, and only the person can approve it. (type, id, other_type, other_id). Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record). Never deletes and never records a payment.

action.description: What to propose; set_fields when left out.

items.description: One object per record, at most 25, with the values the action takes.

at.description: add_note: When the note is from, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out. log_activity: When it took place, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out.

clear.description: set_fields: field keys to empty; only fields describe_record_type marks clearable.

done.description: add_task: True for a task that is already done. update_task: True when the task is done, false to open it again.

due_at.description: add_task: When it is due, ISO 8601 in UTC. update_task: When it is due now, ISO 8601 in UTC.

email.description: send_record: Send to this address instead of the one on the record.

end_at.description: log_activity: When a meeting ended, ISO 8601 in UTC.

fields.description: update_fields: Field names and their new values as text; an empty text empties a field.

id.description: The id of the record in the system. Leave it out with set_fields to make a new record, and with update_task where the system does not ask for it.

name.description: add_line_item: The name of the line.

notes.description: add_task: More text on the task. update_task: The new text on the task. log_activity: More text on it. add_line_item: More text on the line.

other_id.description: link_records, unlink_records: The id of the second record in the system.

other_type.description: link_records, unlink_records: The type of the second record.

pipeline.description: move_stage: The id of the pipeline, only when the stage is in another pipeline than the record's.

quantity.description: add_line_item: How many, as a number.

set.description: set_fields: field keys as describe_record_type names them (email, phone, address.city) and their new values. A money field takes a number.

stage.description: move_stage: The id of the stage to move to, as describe_record_type gives it with include stages.

subject.description: add_task: The title of the task. update_task: The new title of the task.

task_id.description: update_task: The id of the task, as list_related_records or search_tasks gives it.

task_kind.description: add_task: What kind of task it is.

text.description: add_note: The text of the note.

type.description: The record type; link_records and unlink_records also take note or task as the first record. update_task only needs it where the system asks for it.

unit_price.description: add_line_item: The price of one, as a number.

user.description: add_note: The id of the user shown as its writer, as describe_record_type gives it with include users. add_task: The id of the user the task is for, as describe_record_type gives it with include users. update_task: The id of the user the task is for now, as describe_record_type gives it with include users. log_activity: The id of the user who had it, as describe_record_type gives it with include users; some systems need it for a meeting.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

name: propose_changes
title: Propose changes to records
